result.title: FreeDeshadow: Shadow Removal for User-Specified Objects With Multimodal Prompts
result.summary: Existing shadow removal methods either perform global shadow removal or rely on precise shadow masks to guide restoration. Such paradigms limit their ability to selectively remove the shadow cast by a user-specified object in practical applications. To this end, we introduce an object-aware controllable shadow removal task, which allows users to specify a target object through a simple prompt and removes only its cast shadow while preserving other content. However, object-shadow asymmetry makes it challenging to establish accurate correspondence between the specified object and its spatially separated cast shadow and to confine restoration to the target shadow region. To address these challenges, we propose FreeDeshadow, a unified controllable shadow removal framework that supports both visual and textual prompts. It consists of an object-aware generator and a shadow-aware local refiner. The former interprets the user prompt and produces a high-quality shadow-free proposal, while the latter establishes the correspondence between the object and its cast shadow and constrains the generated changes to the target shadow region. To support training and evaluation, we further construct PCSRD+, a large-scale dataset containing 154,571 quadruples at 1024$\times$1024 resolution and covering six types of user prompts. The visual prompts include a dot, a line, and an object mask, while the textual prompts describe the target object using attributes, spatial relations, or states. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FreeDeshadow accurately removes the shadow of the target object under both visual and textual prompts while effectively preserving non-target regions. It also outperforms existing methods in shadow removal performance and controllability. Project Page: https://wzlwlm13.github.io/FreeDeshadow

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出可控的「对象感知去阴影」任务与 FreeDeshadow 框架，通过视觉或文本提示定位用户指定对象并仅移除其投影，同时构建大规模四元组数据集 PCSRD+。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是图像恢复与编辑工作，核心是提示解析与阴影区域局部精修，不涉及推理期内部状态、证据筛选、动态计算或停止决策，对象与阴影的对应也由生成器与精修器结构承担，未提供可核查的 LVR 借鉴线索。
